item.title: Baltimore City Council introduce bill banning private detention centers
item.description: Baltimore City Council introduced a bill to ban private detention facilities in the city, as members push back against ICE amid immigration concerns.

item.title: 20+ years in male-dominated fields, Marine Corps veteran creates space for empowerment with women-only gym
item.description: During Women’s History Month, Marine Corps veteran Sandy Vasquez is being recognized not only for her military service, but for the way she continues to uplift women in her community.

item.title: Feeling like May through mid-week!
item.description: Meteorologist Stevie Daniels says today and Wednesday will feature temperatures around 25° warmer than normal. Thunderstorm chances increase Wednesday afternoon.
